message: No detected input validation: The load_data function reads a CSV directly into a DataFrame with no schema checks, dtype assertions, null checks, or value-range guards.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local filename via pd.read_csv with no remote fetch, checksum verification, or source authentication of any kind.

No detected label flipping detection: The code loads labels directly from the CSV and encodes them without any validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training data during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized models, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision anywhere in the visible code.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads data and encodes labels but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics are computed (accuracy, precision, recall, MSE, confusion matrix), there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other controls preventing metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The load_data function reads CSV data directly into numpy arrays without any shape, range, type, or schema validation before passing to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The output_analytics function processes predictions and computes metrics without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation on model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses a RandomForest/neural network classifier on tabular/audio data, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
